world.description: A steam train circles a wildflower valley on a summer morning.

lines: The poppies came up by themselves. I only keep the paths clear.
params.name: Elsa

lines: Flour on everything, and I would not have it any other way. The wind is good today.
params.name: Miller Odd

params.text: The little train pulls in, steaming. A good morning in the valley.

lines: Twelve sheep, and not one of them has ever come when called.
params.name: Tomas

lines: The next train is on its way round. Take a turn about the valley first: the windmill, the sheep, the cottage garden. Then come back here.
F blows the whistle, if you want the driver to wave.
params.name: Mr Alder
params.persona: a courteous station master with a pocket watch

train-engine.description: Detailed old steam locomotive on a short rail segment, with a riveted boiler, flared smokestack, steam dome, enclosed cab, cowcatcher, six driving wheels, side rods, lamps and period trim.

trimColor.description: metal trim, bands and detail color

intro.objective: Walk the valley from the station: the windmill, the sheep meadow and the cottage garden, then be back on the platform for the train.
intro.tagline: A summer morning, a little steam train and fifty thousand wildflowers.
intro.title: Painterly Meadow

world.name: Painterly Meadow

rules.description: Walking to the windmill counts as a stop

then.text: The windmill: the sails turn slowly in the morning wind.

rules.description: Walking to the sheep counts as a stop

then.text: The sheep meadow: a dozen sheep and one patient shepherd.

rules.description: Walking to the cottage counts as a stop

then.text: The cottage garden: poppies, daisies and a clean path.

rules.description: Three stops made: the platform is the goal

then.text: That is the valley. The next train is due: back to the platform.
Morning at the station. Talk to Mr Alder (E), then walk the valley: windmill, sheep, cottage garden. F blows the whistle.
